summary: WorkPlan work-plan-from-brief-eval.json passes adversarial critique: eleven items each carry a single property-level Gherkin Scenario (Given/When/Then), map 1:1 to calculator.feature and memory.feature, have no dependency cycles, and collectively cover ChangeBrief in_scope and success_criteria (binary ops + remainder, named domain failures for div/rem by zero, single-slot memory start/clear/recall/add/subtract, checkable HTTP/API and module surfaces via acceptance_of_whole).
